messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for tenant Solstice (dedicated-vpc-12). Error rate > 7% over 5m. Impact: generation requests failing with 502/504. Pager sent to #oncall. Incident page: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-1848264 :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): On it. grabbing the runbook. Starting smoke checks against the pool. @bob can you join for customer comms?

bob (escalations): here. pinged @dave to prep a customer note. quick Q: is this a single pool or routing-wide?

carol (sre): preliminary: errors concentrated on Dedicated Pool 12 (us-east1), tenant isolation layer shows elevated retry storms from Solstice app during a sustained burst. I see rapid KV cache thrashing in the logs.

hugo (eng-runtime): looking at the runtime logs now. suspect: cache eviction thrash when prefix cache size + concurrent sessions hit a boundary under quantized model config. fetching stack traces.

alice (oncall): mitigation intent: 1) isolate Solstice traffic to spare instances, 2) apply emergency rate limit for tenant, 3) fallback to older model variant if needed. executing now.

carol (sre): applying per-tenant rate limit: `redwoodctl rate-limit set --tenant solstice --rps 10 --burst 20`

hugo (eng-runtime): spun up 2 warm nodes in pool-12, routing rule adjusted: `route.override --tenant solstice --pool spare-pool-2`

dave (account-eng): Drafting interim note to customer. Need exact impact window and affected features (generation only?). Will we have a short blurb they can send to their execs?

bob (escalations): Affected: text generation and streaming outputs for ~12:13 - ongoing. No embeddings or admin APIs. Please confirm.

erin (support): confirmed via logs: only /v1/generate and streaming endpoints returned 5xx. Embeddings endpoints responded normally.

hugo (eng-runtime): quick mitigation check: after routing to spare-pool-2, errors dropped to 1.2% in 2m. Still seeing increased latency for some sessions.

alice (oncall): good. keeping traffic routed to spare pool while we debug root cause. will keep rate limit in place.

carol (sre): collecting artifacts for RCA: core dumps, runtime heap hist, eviction traces. saving to /mnt/incidents/1848264/artifacts.tar.gz

hugo (eng-runtime): hypothesis: an interaction between `kv-prefix-cache` + `quantize=nl4` path causes incremental size misreport leading to mass eviction. I can reproduce locally with a synthetic load. Preparing a minimal repro.

bob (escalations): Customer note (suggested): "We're aware of increased errors affecting text generation for your dedicated pool. We have isolated your traffic to spare capacity and applied temporary protections. Our engineering team is investigating root cause and we'll follow up with an RCA and remediation plan." Thumbs? :thumbsup:

dave (account-eng): good — add estimated window and apology. Ask if they saw any failed requests they consider high-priority.

erin (support): FYI, Solstice reported 15 failed user-facing requests at 12:18; they flagged two as priority. Logging their request IDs now.

frank (legal): suggested legal-safe phrasing for the public-facing note: avoid language implying data loss or liability. Use "experiencing service disruption" and offer support and credits per SLA.

grace (product): one ask: did any requests hit tenant data crossing boundaries? We need to confirm no tenant isolation breach.

hugo (eng-runtime): data isolation: no cross-tenant traffic observed. Requests were processed by Solstice's instances only; errors were internal 5xx. I'm 95% confident there was no data leakage. I'll add a confirmation step to the RCA.

alice (oncall): can we get a short executive summary for the customer? I'll draft: "Root cause: runtime cache eviction bug triggered under specific model config leading to request failures. Mitigation: isolated traffic, applied rate limits, scaled spare instances. Next: fix will be rolled out with canary, and we'll provide credits per SLA." Thoughts?

carol (sre): fine as interim. For RCA we need timeline, impact numbers (requests, error %, affected users), triggers, fix plan, and preventative actions.

hugo (eng-runtime): tentative fix: bounds-check in cache accounting + guardrail to avoid mass eviction. I'll open PR and link in thread. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/734

bob (escalations): customer comms plan: 1) immediate interim note (sent within 30m), 2) follow-up RCA draft within 48h, 3) executive summary call if customer requests. dave to lead.

dave (account-eng): sending interim note now. copying legal suggested language. I'll include ETA for RCA: 48 hours.

erin (support): also logging the two priority request IDs into the customer ticket: SOL-3482. Customer acknowledged interim note and asked for credit specifics.

frank (legal): for credits: coordinate with finance. Proposed language: "We will apply a service credit consistent with the SLA for affected hours; this does not constitute admission of liability."

alice (oncall): operational checklist: 1) keep rate limit for 2 hours, 2) monitor error rate, 3) hold spare nodes until postmortem, 4) start canary for fix on staging.

hugo (eng-runtime): reproduced locally and added test in CI to cover cache accounting edge. ETA for staged rollout: ~8h for PR + CI + canary.

carol (sre): capturing metrics snapshot: total requests 18,432 during incident window, 2,230 failed (12.1%), peak RPS 720, median latency increase +320ms. Will attach to RCA.

bob (escalations): planning exec update for customer: short slide with timeline, mitigation, root cause summary, next steps, and proposed credit. dave can you prep?

dave (account-eng): yes. will prep slides and propose credit equal to one day of dedicated pool fees (per SLA calc), pending finance sign-off.

frank (legal): I'll review the draft before it goes to customer. Avoid firm promises on monetary amounts until finance signs off.

alice (oncall): changing thread status: mitigation stable, moving to post-incident coordination. Will mark incident as resolved in 2h if error rates stay <2%.

carol (sre): logging follow-ups: - PR rollout and post-deploy verification - add CI regression test - update runbook with eviction thresholds - automate per-tenant circuit breaker

hugo (eng-runtime): PR linked and tests green in my branch. I'll request review from @carol and @alice.

dave (account-eng): interim note sent at 12:47. Customer acknowledges and requested RCA ASAP.

alice (oncall): thanks team. final status update here once we hit the 2h stable mark. Closing action: assign RCA owner (carol) and exec update owner (dave).

incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident INC-1848264 status -> mitigated. Follow-ups: RCA assigned to carol, exec update assigned to dave. Link: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-1848264/postmortem

carol (sre): starting the RCA doc now. Draft link: https://docs.internal/redwood/rca/INC-1848264-draft (will post full doc in 24-48h).
